title: Generate images with AI
subtitle: Describe what you want, or transform an image already in your media.
promptPlaceholder: e.g. a minimalist product photo of a white sneaker on a marble surface, soft studio light
needReference: Add an image to your media first to use this mode.
moderatedOut: That prompt returned no safe image. Try describing it differently.
quotaExhausted: You have reached your AI image limit. Try again later.
quotaNone: No AI images left this month.
quotaLeft: {count, plural, one {Only 1 AI image left this month.} other {Only # AI images left this month.}}
empty: Your generated images will appear here.
pickToAdd: Pick the images you want, then add them to your product media.
captionHint: Printed on each image exactly as you write it, after the image is made. The AI never writes it.
captionRejected: Your text was blocked by the safety filter. Change it and try again.

errors.monthlyCap: This store has used its AI image allowance for this month.
errors.budget: AI image generation is paused for today. It resumes at midnight UTC.
errors.rateLimit: You've made too many AI requests just now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.notAvailable: AI image generation is not enabled on this platform.
errors.promptRejected: That request was blocked by the safety filter.
errors.notAnImage: This file is not an image, so it cannot be enhanced.
errors.notFound: That image is no longer available.
errors.planQuota: You have used this period's allowance for this feature. It resets at the start of the next period, or you can move to a larger plan.
errors.planLimit: Your plan's limit for this has been reached. Remove something, or move to a larger plan.
errors.planBatch: That is more than your plan allows in a single run. Try fewer at a time.
errors.planOption: That option is not available on your plan.
errors.billingDisabled: Self-serve billing is not enabled on this deployment. Contact support to change your plan.
errors.planNotPurchasable: That plan cannot be subscribed to directly. Contact support.
errors.noBillingAccount: This store has no billing account yet. Choose a plan first.
errors.noLiveSubscription: There is no active subscription to change. Choose a plan to start one.
errors.subscriptionExists: This store already has a subscription. Change your current plan instead of starting a second one.
errors.alreadyOnPlan: You are already on this plan. Pick a different one to change.
